_about: USD prices the clip eval uses to estimate and cap spending. Edit this file (or point MIMIR_CLIP_EVAL_PRICING at a JSON file with the same shape, merged over this one) when a price changes. A model missing here is 'unpriced': a run that needs it is refused, because its cost cannot be capped.
_why_conservative: The official pages were not reachable when this file was written. Third-party trackers report a 2026-07-30 cut to gpt-5.6-terra 2.00/12.00 and gpt-5.6-luna 0.20/1.20 per 1M tokens; until that is confirmed the older, higher list prices are used, so estimates and the --max-usd cap err on the expensive side.

estimate._about: Heuristics for runs that have no measured cost yet. Once a case has been run, its measured usage replaces them.

full_stage._after_selection: captions (Qwen Omni x2, gpt-transcribe, Astra judge), diarization, Astra edit director, teaser, headline, speaker roles, memes for ONE short; DashScope Qwen is not in this table, so it is covered by this allowance
